details.reason: MQL5 MqlTick documents time_msc in milliseconds only — no microsecond field in Python API.
details.replacement: Replace Phase 30D timestamp_us with timestamp_ms (broker) + local_send_ns (collector monotonic).

details.reason: No sequence number in MqlTick or copy_ticks output; only time ordering.
details.replacement: Assign collector sequence index per partition; detect gaps via time_msc deltas.

details.reason: MT5 BookInfo is limited depth snapshot; true L2 order book not exposed for standard retail CFD/FX accounts.
details.replacement: Replace with spread widening + partial fill + requote proxies.

details.reason: No aggregate liquidity metric in MT5 API; volume on last trade only, often zero on FX ticks.
details.replacement: Proxy: partial fill rate + TRADE_RETCODE_REQUOTE rate + spread p99 spikes.

details.reason: No MT5 API exposes internal broker matching queue depth or position in queue.
details.replacement: Remove from collector; use execution_delay_ms distribution instead.
